entities.summary: Francisco Igea Arisqueta is a Spanish politician. A doctor by profession, he was a member of the Congress of Deputies (2016–2019), represeting the party Citizens. He led his party in the 2019 Castilian-Leonese regional election, and became vice president of the Junta of Castile and León after forming a government with the People's Party leader Alfonso Fernández Mañueco.
